entities.summary: Muslims fast from dawn to sunset during the month of Ramadan — no food, water, smoking, or sexual activity. The fast builds empathy with the hungry, demonstrates self-discipline, and creates communal solidarity. Iftar (the evening meal breaking fast) is a major social event, often shared with strangers.
